The War of the Twelve Days, which began in June 2025, represented an unprecedented escalation, being the first direct conflict of this magnitude between the two nations. According to official Iranian data, Israeli attacks caused over 1,000 deaths, while Israel reported nearly 30 victims. The US intervention, with bombings of Iranian nuclear facilities, further increased tensions in the region. The ceasefire agreed upon on June 24 was mediated by international actors, although no details have been revealed about the terms of the agreement. Since then, both countries have maintained a bellicose rhetoric, with mutual accusations of violating the conditions of the ceasefire.
